title: Prism carousel
description: An architectural photo strip bends through a clear optical edge, then expands a selected image into an undistorted inspection view.
useCase: Give a compact visual collection a material transition while preserving a clear enlarged image.
interaction: Drag or step through images, then choose Inspect.

assets.description: Chartres Cathedral, West Facade; Royal Portal, Central Bay
Modern brutalist architecture with geometric shapes

reducedMotion: Stepping and inspection settle immediately; the stationary optical treatment remains.
limitations: Native WebGL 1 and three local images. The lens is an artistic UV refraction, not a physically traced glass object; a flat image is the fallback.
look: Light gray stage with a strip of architectural photos bent and stretched toward the edges with RGB fringing, an italic serif caption and arrow buttons.
motion: Dragging or stepping slides the strip through a refracting edge lens, snapping to the nearest print on a damped spring; Inspect relaxes the lens and crossfades to the enlarged print.
adapt: Motion runs in `tick`: a spring (155 stiffness, `Math.exp(-22 * dt)` damping) moves `position` toward `target`, and `focus` eases with a 0.11 s constant; the `prism` shader's `rim` term sets lens strength. Replace `prints`; the atlas assumes three images.
